newsitem.title: UK: HORSE RACING-FALLON TO APPEAL AGAINST 10-DAY BAN.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-FALLON TO APPEAL AGAINST 10-DAY BAN.

text.p: Leading jockey Kieren Fallon is to appeal against a 10-day ban imposed after his mount Musical Dancer veered off course in Sunday's Italian Derby.
Fallon, first jockey for top trainer Henry Cecil, is in danger of losing the ride on the favourite for the Epsom Oaks on June 6 and his mount in the Derby the following day."
Cecil said: "He couldn't do anything about it. It was not intentional. It's a shame because he has been doing so well."
Fallon leads the jockeys' table by five ahead of champion Pat Eddery and Frankie Dettori.
